capacitor_scope: Original GDS-readback .ext ground C distributed by normalized allocation weights retained after Magic resistor-network simplification; original .ext coupling C retained once at logical net nodes. All R/MOS unchanged. After shorting extracted R, the full C matrix matches .ext. Weights originate in geometric tile area but may move during R-weighted merging; conservation does not establish high-frequency spatial accuracy. This is an explicit spatial-C approximation, not a 3D field solution. Native r3 export is an invalid numerical control.
junction_scope: All extracted AD/AS/PD/PS are retained identically. GF180 tech disables explicit active-diffusion junction area/perimeter C, handled inside BSIM through these geometry parameters.
body_and_supply_scope: All raw extracted body and supply RC nodes retained; no ideal shorting or signal-only projection in main full-RC deck.
sum_resistance_warning: Sum of branch R is not port-to-device effective resistance.

capacitance_correction.method: Explicit .ext-ground-C assembly using normalized allocation weights retained after Magic resistor-network simplification; original coupling C retained once. Nets with zero incident coupling and zero Magic weights use explicitly declared logical-node ground-C lumping.

DATA.allocation_basis: Explicit logical-node lumping: zero incident coupling and no Magic weights

findings: ResReadNode: only location/type/resistance read, substrate C not assigned.
ResReadCapacitor: ResOpt_Signal adds each coupling C to both nodes' capacitance.
ResDistributeCapacitance scales node geometric areas by totalcap/totalarea.
Subsequent resistor simplification/merging may relocate capacitance with R weighting; final rnode ratios are post-simplification allocation weights, not raw tile-area ratios.
ResMakeRes adds geometric tile height*width area to rn_area at segment endpoints.
Between breakpoints each resistor endpoint receives half the physical tile segment area.
ResPrintExtNode preserves original named nodes and emits additional rnode C.
efBuildNode adds C for existing node names.
DEV_MSUBCKT fall-through enters unconditional resistor-pi else.
Flat MOS subcircuit writer breaks before resistor-pi branch.

limitations: Ground C weights originate in tile areas but are changed by resistor-network simplification and R-weighted merging; they are not independent physical-area measurements.
A net with no incident coupling has no Magic weights; its exact ground C is lumped at the original logical node, explicitly reported rather than invented.
Coupling C is lumped at original named nets, not local spatial coupling.
C-matrix conservation establishes bookkeeping, not high-frequency spatial accuracy; RCLUMP control is required to assess placement sensitivity.
PDK/Magic/GDS and complete extracted R/MOS network unchanged.
No intrinsic BSIM junction/gate capacitance is added or removed.

model_source: Audited RC assembly, not unmodified Magic ext2spice output
